title: If You’re So Good, You Do It
synopsis: Learn how to say “If you’re so good, you do it!” in Chinese, and how to retort when someone says this to you.

fullText.simplified:
你行你上

    “你行你上”是一个从篮球迷的争论中而来的流行语，现在我们经常可以听到这句话。这句话引申的意思是要尊重别人的努力和成果，不要随便否认别人，你行的话你上去试试，恐怕还不如别人呢！
    比如，一个人说“科比打球打得太差了”，另一个人不同意，他可能就会回一句“你知道科比有多努力吗？你行你上啊”。
    “你行你上”这句话非常简单、好用，但这句话听起来不太礼貌，所以能不用最好不用。如果有人用了这句话，你又该怎么回嘴呢？网上有很多例子，比如：“我不是厨师就不能尝出菜好不好吃？”，“我评论个电冰箱，自己还得会制冷啊”，“我不行，所以我不上。你不行，还要硬上”……
    最近，“你行你上”这个词不仅在国内流行，而且还“踏出国门”了。“你行你上”直译成英文就是“You can you up”，这个中式英语据说被收录到了美国的某个俚语词典上。
fullText.traditional:
你行你上

    “你行你上”是一個從籃球迷的爭論中而來的流行語，現在我們經常可以聽到這句話。這句話引申的意思是要尊重別人的努力和成果，不要隨便否認別人，你行的話你上去試試，恐怕還不如別人呢！
    比如，一個人說“科比打球打得太差了”，另一個人不同意，他可能就會回一句“你知道科比有多努力嗎？你行你上啊”。
    “你行你上”這句話非常簡單、好用，但這句話聽起來不太禮貌，所以能不用最好不用。如果有人用了這句話，你又該怎麼回嘴呢？網上有很多例子，比如：“我不是廚師就不能嘗出菜好不好吃？”，“我評論個電冰箱，自己還得會制冷啊”，“我不行，所以我不上。你不行，還要硬上”……
    最近，“你行你上”這個詞不僅在國內流行，而且還“踏出國門”了。“你行你上”直譯成英文就是“You can you up”，這個中式英語據說被收錄到了美國的某個俚語詞典上。

raw.synopsis: Learn how to say “If you’re so good, you do it!” in Chinese, and how to retort when someone says this to you.
sentence_translations: If You’re So Good, You Do It
“If you’re so good, you do it” is a buzzword originating in arguments among basketball fans.
Nowadays we can often hear this phrase.
This phrase’s extended meaning is that you should respect other people’s hard work and achievements, ..
.. and that you shouldn’t easily discredit others.
If you can do it, then go make an attempt. You probably won’t do much better than others!
For example, if one person says “Kobe is terrible at basketball”, and another person disagrees ..
.. then perhaps they will respond: “Do you know how diligent Kobe is? If you’re so good, why don’t you do it!”
The phrase “If you’re so good, you do it” is very simple and easy to use.
But the phrase doesn’t sound very polite, so if you can avoid using it, it is best not to use it.
If someone uses this phrase, what can you say back?
There are many examples online, for example: “If I’m not a chef, can’t I tell if something tastes good or not?”
“To review a refrigerator, do I have to be able to refrigerate things?”
“I’m no good, that’s why I don’t do it. You’re no good either, but you still insist on doing it.” …
Recently, this phrase “If you’re so good, you do it” is not only popular within China, ..
.. but has even “stepped outside the country gate”.
“If you’re so good, you do it” translated literally into English is “You can you up”.
It is said that this Chinese-style English was included in a certain American slang dictionary.
